newsitem.title: USA: Toro sees Q1 EPS below street expectations.
newsitem.headline: Toro sees Q1 EPS below street expectations.

text.p: Toro Co said Friday it expects first-quarter earnings to be below Wall Street estimates of $0.37 per share.
The company posted earnings of $0.67 a share a year ago.

Toro officials said several factors combined to reduce anticipated results in the first quarter, including the early closing of its acquisition of James Hardie Irrigation Group that shifted some acquisition expense into the quarter.
It said full-year plans and objectives remain on target, and it is confident earnings growth for fiscal 1997 can be achieved.
According to First Call, Toro is expected to post earnings of $3.11 for fiscal 1997, ending October 31.
